pieces.name: engine/bootstrap
pieces.summary: WebGPURenderer + WebGL2 fallback verified headless. Low-res RT upscale, TSL grade/dither/vignette, exposure-lifted night grade.

pieces.name: input/pointer+twin-stick
pieces.summary: Unified pointer events: twin-stick touch + context button, pointerlock mouse + WASD.

pieces.name: world/town
pieces.summary: Textured town: procedural 64px nearest-filtered textures (siding/brick/shingle/asphalt/concrete/wood/stone), porches, shutters, lit windows, church, graveyard, navGrid.

pieces.name: characters/factory
pieces.summary: Quality pass in flight: readable faces (brow/nose/eyes/mouth or 32px face textures), hair per archetype, tapered bodies, tattered player silhouette.

pieces.name: tsl/era effects
pieces.summary: Jitter + affine warp being wired into town/character materials with visual verification.

pieces.name: ai/residents+horde
pieces.summary: 60 NPCs staggered think, wander/flee; horde hunts women autonomously, exponential spread.

pieces.name: gore/kills+blood
pieces.summary: Arterial bursts, persistent decals + trails, body pools, blood stains on her model.

pieces.name: take-cut/first-person
pieces.summary: Hard cut to first-person per take, lurch, handheld shake, snap back. Kiss/kill decided by target.

pieces.name: hud/bars+prompt
pieces.summary: Hunger/rot/evidence bars, stage name, horde + women counts, KISS/KILL context prompt.

pieces.name: escalation/town states
pieces.summary: Clustering, armed men with rifles + fire, pallbearer screening, cordon roadblocks + timer.

pieces.name: audio/CC0 pack
pieces.summary: 22 files, 100% CC0 (freesound), all 6 events with variants. Kill = impact+wet+breath+tail layers.

pieces.name: mood/critic
pieces.summary: R3 gap: 'sterile gray-box voxel diorama' → town textured + relit. R4 judging now.
